xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4626: Stop and archive still show no visible pending state on the conversation row: dim the row and label it

plan.title: Stop and archive still show no visible pending state on the conversation row: dim the row and label it
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: PAN-4584 shipped an archive-pending indicator that looks exactly like a busy agent (the green Loader2 with styles.conversationWorkingSpinner in the status-dot slot) plus an easy-to-miss title shimmer. Stop has no pending state at all: stopMutation has no mutationKey and no onError, and stop() is gated on the hook-wide stopMutation.isPending, so stopping a second conversation while one stop is in flight is silently dropped. Both onSuccess handlers fire invalidateQueries without returning it, so pending ends before the refetched list changes the row and the row snaps back to normal for a moment. The operator saw no difference on the live dashboard.
narratives.Proposal: One shared 'leaving' treatment for stop and archive, as decided in the issue: dim the row (.conversationRowLeaving: opacity 0.45, 150ms transition, pointer-events none; no transition under prefers-reduced-motion), make it inert, and say in words what is happening (flat rows replace the meta line with a muted size-10 Loader2 + 'Archiving…'/'Stopping…'; nested rows append the label after the title). Revert the dot-slot spinner and the archive title shimmer. The stop X becomes an inert spinner. Give stopMutation mutationKey ['conversation-stop'], expose isStopPending(name) via useMutationState, dedupe per name, toast server errors. Both mutations' onSuccess handlers become async and await the ['conversations'] invalidate promise before their side effects, so pending lasts until the refetch lands. The ConversationPanel header shows 'Stopping…' like it shows 'Archiving…'. Docs and live Playwright screenshots complete the slice. Full step-by-step detail lives in the PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4626.md (WI-1..WI-8, D1..D9).
narratives.NonGoals:
- No flash, color pulse, or new animation beyond the opacity transition and the existing spin keyframe.
- No success toast for stop.
- No change to the server stop or archive routes.
- Do not disable or relabel the 'Stop agent' items in ConversationActionMenu.tsx or the ConversationPanel header menu; the per-name dedupe in stop() covers repeat clicks.
- Do not change retitle pending behavior: isRetitlePending still applies titleRegenerating.
- Do not raise any file-size allowlist cap; ConversationPanel.tsx must not grow past 1520 lines.
- Never let a Playwright verification request reach the live server's /archive or /stop endpoints (no route.continue()).

autoDecisions.summary: Archive wins when both archive and stop are pending: leavingKind = archive ? 'archive' : stop ? 'stop' : null.
autoDecisions.rationale: Archiving also ends the session, so 'Archiving…' is the truer label; the issue does not cover the overlap.

autoDecisions.summary: The label and stop-button spinner use a new muted .conversationLeavingSpinner class, not .conversationWorkingSpinner.
autoDecisions.rationale: .conversationWorkingSpinner is color var(--success) green, the exact signal the issue removes as confusable.
The stop button is hover-only (opacity 0); pointer-events none ends hover, so without this the issue's stop spinner would be invisible.

autoDecisions.summary: Inert means no handlers: the pending stop span has no onClick/onKeyDown/tabIndex, and the row root's onClick/onContextMenu return early while leaving.
autoDecisions.rationale: pointer-events none does not stop keyboard activation in a browser or fireEvent.click in jsdom, and the issue requires the X to do nothing when clicked.

autoDecisions.summary: The panel's status span gets aria-label 'Archiving conversation' / 'Stopping conversation' and tests query by role+name.
autoDecisions.rationale: The panel already renders 'Stopping…' for the turn-abort button, so text alone is ambiguous.

autoDecisions.summary: Register useConversationMutations.archive.test.tsx and the new useConversationMutations.stop.test.tsx in root package.json test:frontend-subset.
autoDecisions.rationale: CI runs only listed frontend files; the archive suite from PAN-4584 is not listed, so neither suite would ever run on CI.

autoDecisions.summary: stopConversation parses the JSON error body like archiveConversation.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for the server message in the error toast; handleConversationStop returns { error } on 404 and 500.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-1 exactly. narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-2 and decision D6. Make archiveMutation.onSuccess async: FIRST `await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['conversations'] });` (comment: awaited so the mutation stays pending — row dimmed — until the refetched list drops the row, PAN-4626), THEN closeConversationPanes(name), the deselect, and the success toast. Make stopMutation.onSuccess async the same way: await the invalidate, then deselect. Side effects go after the await because closing a pane during the refetch would unmount a pane-hosted ConversationPanel and TanStack drops mutate-level callbacks (onArchived) of unmounted callers. Add one test per suite that mounts an ACTIVE observer — renderHook(() => { useQuery({ queryKey: ['conversations'], queryFn, staleTime: Infinity }); return useConversationMutations(null, vi.fn()); }) with a deferred queryFn — because the existing setup() has no observer and invalidateQueries would resolve at once (a vacuous pass). Assert pending is true after queryFn has been called once (POST already resolved) and false after resolving the deferred refetch; in the archive case also assert toast.success, closeConversationPanes and the per-call onSuccess are not called before the refetch resolves and are called after. Use the exact shape in PRD WI-2 step 3; no real setTimeout waits. In the stop case render useConversationMutations('a', onSelect) with onSelect = vi.fn() and assert onSelect is not called before the refetch resolves and is called once with null after.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-8 after all code items land. Start the workspace's own Vite frontend on a free port (not 3010): `cd src/dashboard/frontend && VITE_PROXY_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:3011 npx vite --port <port>` — :3011 itself serves the deployed dist, not this branch. Use an isolated Playwright browser context (no shared profile). Register page.route for '**/api/conversations/*/archive' and '**/api/conversations/*/stop' that wait ~5 s and then route.fulfill({ status: 500, contentType: 'application/json', body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'UAT intercept' }) }). NEVER call route.continue(): a continued request really archives or kills the operator's live conversation. Trigger archive (row menu → Archive → confirm) on one row and stop (hover X) on a live row; screenshot each mid-request to docs/screenshots/pan-4626/mid-archive.png and docs/screenshots/pan-4626/mid-stop.png, and one under page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' }) to docs/screenshots/pan-4626/mid-archive-reduced-motion.png (repo convention: docs/screenshots/pan-<n>/). Inspect the PNGs yourself. After the fulfil, confirm the error toast and the restored row. Commit the three PNGs with the trailer 'Item: uat-screenshots' and push. Once the PR exists, embed mid-archive.png and mid-stop.png in its body as ![…](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eltmon/overdeck/feature/pan-4626/docs/screenshots/pan-4626/<file>.png) via gh pr edit --body-file. Stop the Vite server.
